pick.name: Zoho Mail Forever Free
pick.why: Only real free hosted mailbox (send+receive from you@domain with proper DKIM)
pick.free_limits: Up to 5 users, 5 GB/user, 1 domain; NO IMAP/POP/ActiveSync (web + Zoho apps only); 'available only in select data centers'

alts.name: Cloudflare Email Routing + a sending relay
alts.what: Forward you@domain to Gmail; send via Resend/Brevo SMTP
alts.why: Free and keeps Gmail UI; good for aliases
alts.free_limits: 200 rules/domain, 200 destination addresses/account, 25 MiB inbound; receive-only unless you add an SMTP relay

alts.name: Google Workspace Business Starter
alts.why: Pay-later pick for enterprise/healthcare trust and IMAP
alts.free_limits: No free plan (price not re-verified this session)

candidates.name: Cloudflare Email Routing
candidates.verdict: Alt: free forwarding, needs relay to send

candidates.name: Google Workspace
candidates.verdict: Alt: buy when an enterprise buyer expects it

candidates.name: Porkbun email forwarding
candidates.verdict: Free forwarding (20 forwards) if you register there

candidates.name: Zoho Mail Lite
candidates.verdict: Cheap paid upgrade with IMAP (price not shown in fetch)

decision: Zoho Free is the only $0 real mailbox; the lack of IMAP is acceptable if you use Zoho's apps. Switch to Google Workspace when you start enterprise/healthcare sales cycles.
details: Set SPF, DKIM and DMARC whichever you pick.

verify.note: Zoho Mail Forever Free: 5 users, 5 GB/user, 1 domain, no IMAP/POP/ActiveSync, 'available only in select data centers' (which DCs is not stated, so confirm it is offered on the India DC at signup).
